population.span: The CANVAS Program integrated data from two trials involving a total of 10,142 participants with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk.

treatment_strategy.span: Participants in each trial were randomly assigned to receive canagliflozin or placebo

follow_up.span: Participants in each trial were randomly assigned to receive canagliflozin or placebo and were followed for a mean of 188.2 weeks.

absent_reason.endpoint: No supplied source reports hospitalization for heart failure alone as an endpoint with its own estimate; the CANVAS-R registry reports a composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure.
absent_reason.estimate: The served HR 0.67 appears only in served-row metadata quoting PMID 29526832, which is not included in sources[].text.
absent_reason.ci: The served interval 0.52–0.87 is not stated for hospitalization for heart failure alone in any supplied source.
absent_reason.analysis_set: No supplied source identifies the analysis population for the served hospitalization-for-heart-failure-alone estimate. Registry ITT statements concern other endpoints.

served_mismatch: The served HR 0.67 (0.52–0.87) cannot be verified from the supplied sources. Its provenance is labelled fulltext_verified, but the cited evidence is an abstract quotation from PMID 29526832 present only in served-row metadata; no full text or that abstract is supplied as source text.

candidate_rejections.span: RESULT OUTCOME 1 ANALYSIS 0: groups Placebo, Canagliflozin (Experimental) | Hazard Ratio (HR) 0.72 (95% CI 0.55 to 0.94)
candidate_rejections.why: This estimate concerns the composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure in CANVAS-R, not hospitalization for heart failure alone across the integrated CANVAS Program.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The entry population matches type 2 diabetes with high cardiovascular risk, but the supplied sources do not establish inclusion of participants both with and without baseline heart failure.
